prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 13 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1162; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headaches consistent with whiplash-type injury. The mechanism of injury is plausible for a collision of this nature. Over the course of 13 visits, the patient received conservative management including manual therapy, a home exercise program, and posture education. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical spine, with reduced range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness documented at initial evaluation. No prior injury to the cervical region is known to this provider. Treatment followed a usual and expected course, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms steadily improved and range of motion returned toward baseline. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries. At the time of discharge from active care, the patient was improving and was instructed to continue the home exercise program as needed.
